propositions: A new CLI verb `rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>...` must expose retroactive commit linking on all three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with all-or-nothing SHA validation via git rev-parse.
The seam-level validation calls `commit_impact.invalid_commit_shas` before appending COMMITS events; if any SHA fails, no event is recorded and the call raises naming every offender.

A deterministic close check in `close_precheck.py` blocks if any commit's changed paths are neither declared in `file_impact` nor matched by exemption globs (`tests/**`, `docs/**`, `**/*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), with the message naming the offending paths and remedying via `rebar set-file-impact`.
Merge commits are explicitly skipped (not read as empty path lists); source-(ii) local commits fail closed on git errors; source-(i) linked commits are skipped if absent locally.
The `**/`-aware glob helper is hoisted to `commit_impact.glob_match` as a DET module with no `rebar.llm` import; both former `_glob_match` copies in `prompts.py` and `registry.py` delegate to it.

The close gate discovers commits from both COMMITS events and transitive-descendant referencing commits (with trailer or subject), then unions `file_impact` over the same id set to prevent false-blocks on parent tickets when children declare child-owned paths.
